---
title: "Florida & U.S. Census Geography"
subtitle: "County- and state-level patterns in income and Hispanic population"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)

fl_census <- readRDS("data/fl_census.rds")
us_states <- readRDS("data/us_states.rds")

fl_county_labels <- fl_census |>
  mutate(county_label = str_remove(NAME, " County, Florida")) |>
  st_transform(3086) |>
  st_point_on_surface()
fl_county_labels$label_x <- st_coordinates(fl_county_labels)[, 1]
fl_county_labels$label_y <- st_coordinates(fl_county_labels)[, 2]
fl_census_map <- st_transform(fl_census, 3086)
```

## Florida Counties

These maps show both Hispanic or Latino population share and median household
income across all 67 Florida counties. County names are labeled directly on
each map.

```{r}
#| label: florida-hispanic-map
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-align: center

ggplot(fl_census_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = hispanic_pct), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = fl_county_labels,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = county_label),
    color = "#172033",
    size = 2.6,
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    segment.color = "grey35",
    segment.size = 0.25,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 2026,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1, accuracy = 1),
    name = "Hispanic / Latino\npopulation"
  ) +
  coord_sf(crs = 3086, default_crs = st_crs(3086), datum = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Hispanic or Latino Population by County",
    subtitle = "Share of county residents, 2018–2022",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2018–2022 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.width = unit(3, "cm")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: florida-income-map
#| fig-width: 9

ggplot(fl_census_map) +

    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    segment.color = "grey35",
    segment.size = 0.25,

  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
```

## United States

The national maps compare all 50 states. Alaska and Hawaii are shown in
separate panels so they remain visible at a useful scale; state postal
abbreviations identify each map area.

```{r}
#| label: us-state-maps
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-align: center

small_northeast_states <- c("CT", "RI", "MA", "VT", "NH", "ME", "NJ", "DE", "MD")
conus <- us_states |>
  filter(!STUSPS %in% c("AK", "HI", small_northeast_states))
alaska <- us_states |> filter(STUSPS == "AK")
hawaii <- us_states |> filter(STUSPS == "HI")
northeast <- us_states |> filter(STUSPS %in% small_northeast_states)

state_map_panel <- function(data, variable, projection, panel_title, palette, limits, labels, legend_title) {
  map_data <- st_transform(data, projection)
  label_data <- map_data |>
    st_point_on_surface()
  label_data$label_x <- st_coordinates(label_data)[, 1]
  label_data$label_y <- st_coordinates(label_data)[, 2]

  ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[variable]]), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_data,
      aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = STUSPS),
      color = "#172033",
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.2,
      point.padding = 0.15,
      segment.color = "grey35",
      segment.size = 0.25,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      seed = 2026,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = palette,
      limits = limits,
      labels = labels,
      name = legend_title
    ) +
    coord_sf(crs = projection, default_crs = st_crs(projection), datum = NA) +
    labs(title = panel_title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = unit(3, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

state_map <- function(variable, title, palette, labels, legend_title) {
  state_limits <- range(us_states[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE)

  (
    state_map_panel(
      conus, variable, 5070, "Contiguous states", palette,
      state_limits, labels, legend_title
    ) |
      state_map_panel(
        alaska, variable, 3338, "Alaska", palette,
        state_limits, labels, legend_title
      ) |
      state_map_panel(
        hawaii, variable, 26905, "Hawaii", palette,
        state_limits, labels, legend_title
        ) |
        state_map_panel(
          northeast, variable, 5070, "Northeast detail", palette,
          state_limits, labels, legend_title
        )
  ) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1.1, 0.8, 1.6), guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = title,
      caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2018–2022 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
    ) &
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

state_map(
  "hispanic_pct",
  "Hispanic or Latino Population Share by State",
  "plasma",
  label_percent(scale = 1, accuracy = 1),
  "Hispanic / Latino population"
)

state_map(
  "med_incomeE",
  "Median Household Income by State",
  "viridis",
  label_dollar(),
  "Median household income"
)
```

## County and State Estimates

Search, sort, or filter the table to inspect population, Hispanic or Latino
population share, and median household income for every Florida county and
every U.S. state. Values are ACS 5-Year Estimates for 2018–2022.

```{r}
#| label: geographic-data-table

county_table <- fl_census |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    Geography = "Florida county",
    Name = str_remove(NAME, " County, Florida"),
    State = "Florida",
    Population = total_popE,
    `Hispanic population` = hispanicE,
    `Hispanic population (%)` = hispanic_pct / 100,
    `Median household income` = med_incomeE
  )

state_table <- us_states |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    Geography = "U.S. state",
    Name = state_name,
    State = STUSPS,
    Population = total_popE,
    `Hispanic population` = hispanicE,
    `Hispanic population (%)` = hispanic_pct / 100,
    `Median household income` = med_incomeE
  )

bind_rows(county_table, state_table) |>
  arrange(Geography, Name) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    ),
    caption = "Florida Counties and U.S. States: 2018–2022 ACS Estimates"
  ) |>
  formatRound(
    columns = c("Population", "Hispanic population"),
    digits = 0,
    mark = ","
  ) |>
  formatPercentage(
    columns = "Hispanic population (%)",
    digits = 1
  ) |>
  formatCurrency(
    columns = "Median household income",
    currency = "$",
    digits = 0
  )
```
